data.alt_text: Bar chart of sample retention figures.

data.target_excerpt: [DRY-RUN] Everyone's shipping AI agents, but almost no one is measuring whether they actually reduce human workload.
data.comment: The deflection rate everyone celebrates hides the real cost: our own agent deflected 32% of tickets, but the escalations came in with worse context than a blank form. Handoff quality is the metric that actually matters, and most dashboards ignore it.
data.why_it_works: Adds a concrete counter-metric and takes a firm stance — no hedging.

data.target_excerpt: [DRY-RUN] Most companies don't have an LLM problem, they have a retrieval problem. Better context beats a bigger model.
data.comment: This is exactly right, and the numbers back it up. Swapping to a smaller model with clean, recent context cut our costs ~40% with no noticeable quality drop. The real work lives in the data pipeline, not the model card.
data.why_it_works: States a clear opinion and reinforces it with a specific outcome.

data.target_excerpt: [DRY-RUN] GenAI will transform retention marketing in APAC. WhatsApp + AI personalization is the next big unlock.
data.comment: Personalization is the smaller half of this. In APAC the real lever is timing — a WhatsApp win-back three days after a lapsed order beats a perfectly worded email a week later. Channel latency, not copy, is what moves the number.
data.why_it_works: Takes a definite position and names the underrated factor.
